note.seed_formula: seed = timestamp + walletAddress + lastTxnId (lastTxnId=0 for initial note)
note.rotation: after every successful SECURE action, lastTxnId becomes the new tx signature (or a deterministic tx id)

acceptance_tests.description: Initialize all contracts & deploy to specified chain (localnet/devnet)
steps: Set env.CHAIN to localnet or devnet
Verify all required programs are deployed: Vault + Note/Receipt + Adapter
Verify init instructions executed (vault state accounts exist)

acceptance_tests.description: Airdrop env.DEPLOYER 5 SOL and supply 4 SOL into Vault
steps: Assert env.DEPLOYER balance decreased by ~4 SOL + fees
Assert vault SOL balance increased by 4 SOL

acceptance_tests.description: Create project USDC mint and mint 10^6 USDC into Vault
steps: Create vault token account for USDC
Mint 1,000,000 USDC to the vault token account
Assert vault USDC token account balance == 1,000,000

acceptance_tests.description: After bootstrap, Vault has 4 SOL + 10^6 USDC
steps: Query vault USDC token account balance
Assert env.PUBLIC_WALLET balance == 2 SOL (minus possible fees if used)

acceptance_tests.description: Each wallet has exactly one active note; seed rule uses timestamp + walletAddress + lastTxnId
steps: Perform SECURE Supply; capture new note
Assert only one note is marked active in LOCAL_STORAGE for wallet A
Assert note seed inputs reflect (timestamp, walletAddress=A, lastTxnId=txid from previous action)

acceptance_tests.description: Supply (FAST): routes directly to underlying lending adapter
steps: Supply a small amount of SOL/USDC
Verify tx signature exists and adapter.supply called
Verify no note/proof UI is required

acceptance_tests.description: Supply (SECURE): generates ZK proof, returns a note, and Save-to-storage writes LOCAL_STORAGE
steps: Wait for proof generation step to complete
Verify UI shows proof blob (or proof hash) and a note
Verify note is stored in LOCAL_STORAGE under wallet-specific key

acceptance_tests.description: Borrow/Repay/Withdraw each support FAST and SECURE modes with the same note/proof flow
steps: From a wallet with an existing note, run Borrow in FAST mode; verify no proof UI
Run Borrow in SECURE mode; verify proof->note->optional local save

acceptance_tests.description: Portfolio requires a note: if missing, require paste/import or create initial note
steps: Clear LOCAL_STORAGE for the app domain
Verify app blocks position display and prompts for note import or create initial note

acceptance_tests.description: Deposit/Supply creates receipt/note and updates broker aggregate position
steps: Verify aggregate position (broker account) updates accordingly

acceptance_tests.description: Borrow delivers assets to user and updates debt
steps: Verify debt state increased in broker aggregate

acceptance_tests.description: Repay reduces debt and enables Withdraw when safe
steps: Attempt Withdraw; verify it is allowed only when safe
